lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-intensity circular pixel clusters is visible posterior to the gill slits. The spacing increases along the posterior-horizontal axis, with local maxima forming roughly equidistant nodes in the mid-flank region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with the horizontal rows of blobs, particularly evident in the mid-flank area where they form the vertical components of a grid-like pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, showing a distinct light-to-shadow vertical gradient indicating relief along a trajectory parallel to the lateral line.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible portion of the first dorsal fin in the upper right quadrant displays a sparse arrangement of circular high-luminance blobs, with approximately 8-12 distinct points detectable within the fin's leading and medial surface area.

other_distinctive_markers: Dynamic caustic networks caused by surface light refraction are present across the dorsal-lateral surface. Two remoras (Echeneidae) are visible in the ventral-posterior field of view.
